radiusSource: Radius 16.754 solar radii from McDonald, Zijlstra & Watson (2017), MNRAS 471, 770, table 2, HIP 3419: radius 16.754 solar radii, implied by the fitted luminosity 137.825 solar luminosities (fractional uncertainty 0.052) and temperature (https://doi.org/10.1093/mnras/stx1433): 11,655,758 km at 695,700 km per solar radius.
